= Lazy patterns

Loading this module adds `(freeze Pattern)` to Shen's function patterns.
Matching forces the lazy value with `thaw`, then matches `Pattern` against
the result.

[source,shen]
----
(define force
  { (lazy A) --> A }
  (freeze X) -> X)

(force (freeze (+ 20 22)))
\\ Result: 42
----

A match thaws its input each time it is attempted. Use `lazy.memo` when
the same delayed computation may be matched or thawed repeatedly and its
successful result should be evaluated only once.
